title: 1:8 Off-Road Buggy Nationals 2025 - Crashes, Speed & Glory
description:
Experience the intensity and adrenaline of the 2025 Norwegian 1:8 Off-Road Nationals, held at Hof Modellbilklubb. This video captures the high-speed action, precision driving, and the electrifying atmosphere as top drivers battle for supremacy in both electric and nitro classes. Whether you're a seasoned RC enthusiast or new to the sport, this footage showcases the thrill and skill of competitive RC racing. Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more high-octane RC action!

#RCRacing #1_8OffRoad #NitroBuggy #ElectricBuggy #RCHighlights #RCRacingNorway #offroadracing #hmbk #xrayracing  #kyosho  #Mugen #serpentrc

title: Bumblebee on Rhododendron – A Quiet Moment in the Garden
description: A calm, close-up video of a bumblebee exploring a blooming rhododendron flower. Shot in my backyard using the Sony FX30 and a Sigma 70–200mm lens (effective 450mm crop). There's no music — just gentle sound design to match the slow, natural pace.
